title: OSM context snapshot provenance

geometry_handling.rule: Preserve full geometry for every way intersecting its query bbox; no tile/image content is copied.

transformation: Read the two local raw Overpass JSON snapshots listed above.
Deduplicate by OSM element type and id.
Retain only the declared context classes and a minimal tag allow-list.
Convert node/way geometry to GeoJSON without clipping full intersecting ways.
Write a minified data-only JavaScript assignment plus this provenance JSON; no remote runtime request is made.
use: Draw an attributed public context layer and indexed conceptual sections; do not infer current condition or authorization.
limitations: Not official/canonical geometry, not a current survey or completeness guarantee, not title/accessibility/fire/source/operating evidence, and not authorization. Verify every feature before professional use.
privacy: No individual movement, device, image, health, identity or trajectory data are present.
